case: PostgreSQL CASE enum parameter inference with a domain over the target enum and a shadowed search_path
contract: The CASE parameter occupies both result branches while the opposite branch is a column of a domain over the target enum.
A same-named decoy enum leads transaction search_path; parameter inference still selects the target base enum.
The literal NULL enum label, empty enum label and SQL NULL are compared to schema-qualified native expressions.
pg_typeof checks parameter and CASE result types while the source column retains its outer domain type.
Invalid shadow-only labels retain SQLSTATE 22P02 and source rows remain unchanged.
